title: Carpenter Jeans - Medium Wash
sourceText: Built from the body of our best-selling Work Pants. We took this classic workwear style and made it our own with contrast stitching and a decorative seam on the leg. Pockets galore, hammer loop, and our signature key loop on the waist band. These jeans are made from a heavy-duty 14.5oz 100% cotton denim that was custom woven for us in one of America’s oldest denim mills. Woven in our signature broken twill pattern to call upon fabrics from the past. Softened using eco-friendly abrasives meant to mimic stonewashing— This process saves water, electricity, time, and creates almost zero waste compared to traditional stonewashing. These jeans are a timeless staple and will only get better and better with each wear. Please note-- — There will be slight variations on washes. These carpenter jeans are made from a heavyweight 100% cotton non-stretch denim. Although these pieces have been softened, they are still unbroken-in denim and will be a little stiff to begin with. They will break-in with time and will slowly become softer and more comfortable after each wear. Due to the thickness of the denim, your size may feel a touch smaller than typical. Designed, cut, sewn, and pre-shrunk in Los Angeles on American milled 14.5oz denim. Softened using eco-friendly abrasives.

title: Cathedral Maiden Dress
sourceText: Cathedral Maiden Dress is a figure-flattering gothic midi dress made for comfort, movement, and standout romantic goth style. The flexible smocked back bodice hugs comfortably while adapting to curves, and an invisible side zipper makes slipping it on quick and easy. A vintage-inspired square neckline is finished with a subtle keyhole + tie detail , while short puff sleeves add soft structure. The dramatic cathedral architecture print along the skirt brings a bold, dark elegance—perfect for pairing with platform boots, lace-up heels, or layered belts and harnesses. The hidden pockets keep it practical for events, concerts, and nights out. Fit notes: Model is 5'6" wearing a size XS. Other model is 5'10" wearing a size 2XL. Why you’ll love it: The Tencel-linen blend offers a breathable, smooth hand-feel with a natural drape—ideal for dressing up your everyday rotation while staying comfortable through the day. FAQ: Does it have pockets? Yes—hidden side pockets. Is the fit flexible? The smocked back bodice offers stretch and a curve-friendly fit. How do you get it on? It features an invisible side zipper for easy dressing.

sourceText: We'll be lounging around in these all summer! These shorts are as comfy as they are cute, with soft mesh ruffles and an elastic drawstring waistband. Fully lined, so no need to worry about layering, though they're also a perfect piece to throw on over a swimsuit for a day at the boardwalk! Shell: 100% polyester Lining: 95% polyester, 5% spandex Part of our My Violet Originals. Designed by us and made by our reputable production partner in China.

title: Clover Bunny Ear Hoodie - Pink
sourceText: Spring has sprung! This suuuuper oversized lightweight hoodie is the perfect piece to throw on for a nice walk, and pairs perfectly with our Ribbon Sweat Shorts (tuck it in slightly in the front for a cute romper look!). The hood sports a pair of super floppy, oversized bunny ears and the zipper is accented with a cute heart-shaped zipper pull. The high low hem allows you to wear it over cute high waisted skirts without losing any detail but you can also wear it over biker shorts knowing that we've got your bum covered! title: Charlotte Blazer - Pink/White
sourceText: The blazer of our dreams! title: Skeleton Pullover Sweater
sourceText: This oversized pullover will keep you cozy and feeling festive all Halloween season and beyond! The custom skeleton applique matches pairs perfectly with the matching joggers, but also looks great layered over shorts or a skirt. 80% cotton, 20% polyester Please note the appliqué is designed to fray around the edges and will develop a distressed look with washing and wear. Models wearing size L and XL, 2X, and the one in the store is a 4X My Violet original, designed by us in LA and made in partnership with our reputable factory in china.

title: Prism Panel Shorts - 2X,4X & 5X left!
sourceText: These pastel color blocked shorts are a summer staple!  A pair of hidden zipper pockets at the side seams and two cute fluffy cloud-shaped pockets at the back offer the perfect place to stash your essentials, and the waistband features a drawstring with a cute star bead for extra adjustability. Pair these shorts with the matching Prism Panel Hoodie to make it a set! 80% cotton 20% polyester Fit is true to size. First model is wearing XS, second model is wearing 2X. title: Striped Bat Collar Cardigan
sourceText: A Halloween twist on our Angel Academy Cardigans, these pastel striped sweaters have been upgraded with a fully detachable bat-wing sailor collar and a bat rosette brooch to match. The brooch and the collar are completely removable for extra versatility and ease of washing! Front features two full size pockets, perfect for stashing halloween goodies! 100% cotton Pink haired model is wearing a size XS My Violet original, designed by us in LA and made in partnership with our reputable factory in china.

title: Peropero Sparkles Skort
sourceText: Our ultimate dream collab; PeroPero Sparkles is a cute trio of glittery eyed aliens created by japanese artist Yurie Sekiya. This skort features screen printed stars and an embroidered PeroPero Sparkles logo in Japanese on the hem. The thick ribbed waistband has both elastic and a functional drawstring for adjustability. Two plush pompoms (reminiscent of Melo's tail) sit at the end of the drawstrings. It has built in bloomer shorts made of a soft cotton jersey for comfort and to keep your cheeks covered. And of course there are pockets! Fit is true to size but can be snug at the waist! If you prefer a looser waist we recommend sizing up one size and using the functional drawstring to cinch! For reference the first model is a size small wearing the small and the second model is a size 3X wearing the 3X. Outer fabric is 80% cotton, 20% polyester. Bloomers fabric is 100% cotton. This piece was intented to be worn as a set with our PeroPero Sparkles embroidered hoodie, but it can be styled with lots of different tops! This one is sure to become a staple of your wardrobe. Part of the My Violet Originals collection. Designed by us and made by our reputable production team in china.

title: Aurora Babydoll - Blue
sourceText: For the ones who want to feel like a tiered rainbow cake. sourceText: The classic duffle coat. In spongy, comfy wool. We were incredibly intentional about every detail from the raised seams to the horn-shaped toggles. There’s a roomy hood, button tab neckline, hip pockets, and a curved hem. This is one of those pieces you’ll have forever and maybe even pass down. Timeless, luxurious, essential. Shell: 80% Wool 15% Polyester 5% Others Lining: 100% Polyester Dry Clean Only

title: Elbe Popover Stretch Linen Blend Shirt - Orchid
sourceText: This is the button-down that started it all: our iconic Elbe Shirt, now in our best-selling stretch linen blend. This version boasts a classic fit and a popover style with a half placket that buttons to the center chest. Made from our lightweight, breathable linen blend with our signature invisible stretch, it’s engineered for maximum freedom of movement. No awkward gaping. No button popping.

title: Leonora Sweater Skirt - Autumnal Red
sourceText: Made from our signature Better-Than-Wool yarn, this soft yet structured knitted skirt has a gentle A-line silhouette and is finished with a number of smart features, including encased elastic at the waistband that holds it in place and prevents it from rolling. It also features a self-locking zip closure that keeps the zipper securely closed while you wear it. Unlined so you can feel the sumptuous yarn against your skin, the skirt is designed without pockets for a sleek silhouette.

title: Kelsey Denim Jacket - Americana Wash with Red Stitching
sourceText: The ultimate denim jacket. Tailored to perfection in stretch denim that moves with you. Designed in a versatile medium wash with contrast stitching and functional pockets, this jacket is your go-to lightweight layer.

title: Kidjo Tailored Wool Blend Jacket - Barcarolle Gray
sourceText: Meet your perfect city coat. Tailored and chic, it’s made from our luxe wool blend. Key details include the single button closure, patch pockets at the hips, and a subtle peplum-style hem. We love wearing this style with a dressier outfit but it also looks cute with jeans.

title: Savvy Fine Knit Everyday Sweater Dress - Capulet Olive
sourceText: Sophisticated and easy: the refined silhouette and soft feel of our everyday sweater dress make sweater dressing both a necessity and a pleasure for fall. Cut with an easy fit at the bust and waist, and with ample room in the sleeves, our sweater dress skims the hip and is finished with fine rib trims that feel smooth against the skin. A lightweight sweater dress that can be worn solo or layered with your favorite winter coat.

title: Gabrielle Button-Front Cardigan - Black
sourceText: Elegance is the Gabrielle Cardigan. Simple, sleek, and versatile, our crew-neck cardigan nods to classic vintage style, but in a thoroughly modern way. Cut a little shorter in the body so that it kisses the high hip, the modern proportions of this style allow it to fit seamlessly into your everyday outfitting needs. Made using our signature Better-than-Wool yarn, this jacquard knit offers a bit more structure without sacrificing any softness against the skin. The placket is engineered to prevent spreading, making it wearable as both a cardigan and a top. Finally, the button details, pockets, and finishes add that extra touch of class.

title: Minimalist Stretch Cotton Chambray Shirt - Woodstock Indigo
sourceText: Meet the quintessential, wear-anywhere shirt your closet has been waiting for. Made from lightweight, stretch cotton chambray that's breathable (aka perfect to wear on its own or layerable with other essentials) this staple is complete with all the shirting details that make it a keep-forever piece. Designed with tailoring tricks like hidden snaps in between tortoise buttons for extra security at the bust, and a longer hem that gives full coverage in the back and allows you to tie it up in the front - the styling possibilities are truly endless. Pair with casual jersey pants for a laid-back look, a smart trouser for a little elevation, or go denim on denim for an unapologetic Canadian tuxedo moment.

title: Maine Stretch Flannel Shirt - Garnet Plaid
sourceText: Your quintessential oversize shirt for every day. It looks like fall and feels so luxurious you’ll wear it all year long. Made from an incredibly soft and stretchy flannel, it’s bouncy and light. Details include the button placket, chest pockets, button cuffs, and curved hem.

title: Soft Spun Polo Sweater - Rothko Purple
sourceText: The lofty, lush feel of our Soft Spun yarn is perfect for the Celeste Polo Sweater. This smooth-to-the-touch knit is cut with ease through the body, with fuller sleeves that softly balloon at the cuffs and a ribbed hem that finishes at the hip, creating a soft blouson effect at the waist. Smart enough to wear as a top and cozy enough to layer, too.

title: UltimateS Dolci Top - Fine Stripe in Navy/White
sourceText: We made this fan-favorite lounge top in our light-as-air UltimateS fabric. Meet the softer Dolci Top. Designed with an easy, off-the-shoulder look, this top is all about effortless style. You can lounge while looking good.

title: The Refined Etta High Rise Straight Leg Jeans 28 Inch - Saint Lawrence Blue
sourceText: The Etta High Rise Straight Leg Jeans are where vintage and modern styles meet. If you're looking for a classic '90s-inspired straight cut jean, you've found it! We constructed the Etta Jeans for those who have less than a 10" waist-to-hip difference, for a true straight fit through the hip and leg. Made from structured denim that is so deceptively stretchy... you may even forget you're wearing jeans. Designed in aged denim washes that only look better wear after wear - just like your favorite vintage look, but better. These are the classic jeans just waiting to be styled with your best button down and cute sneakers. Rise : High Hip Fit : Straight Leg Fit : Straight
